title: Speech and Language Therapist
pay: Up to £45,000 a year, depending on experience
summary: Join the therapy team at an Ofsted Outstanding therapeutic school, with Vitality healthcare and a MacBook.
body:
## The position

Are you an experienced speech and language therapist looking to make a profound impact on young people's lives? A leading trauma-centred therapeutic school in Chelmsford is seeking a dedicated SALT to join its highly skilled, collaborative therapy team.

## About the school

This exceptional school offers unique, meaningful and life-changing work with pupils who have experienced significant challenges. Since 2012 the organisation has been at the forefront of therapeutic education, with its schools in Essex and London rated Outstanding in all areas by Ofsted.

## The role

- Work full time across the school's Essex sites as part of an established multidisciplinary therapeutic team.
- Support pupils with Education, Health and Care (EHC) plans, particularly those with adverse childhood experiences (ACEs) and SEMH needs.
- Deliver targeted speech, language and communication interventions tailored to each child's developmental and emotional profile.
- Work closely with teachers, therapists and pastoral teams to promote holistic progress and wellbeing.
- Contribute to the school's trauma-informed approach, helping pupils communicate, connect and thrive.

## What you'll need

- A qualified, experienced speech and language therapist, ideally HCPC registered.
- Experience working with pupils with SEMH, ACEs or complex communication needs.
- A strong understanding of therapeutic, relational approaches in educational or clinical settings.
- Excellent communication skills, a team player's attitude and a passion for helping children overcome barriers to learning.

## Benefits

- New, highly competitive pay scales (up to £45,000).
- Be part of a unique, seamless therapeutic team model.
- Vitality private healthcare, including health, medical and dental cover, lifestyle rewards and discounted gym membership.
- An Apple MacBook for use at school and home.
- Excellent career progression and high-quality CPD.
- Up to 100% funding for relevant professional qualifications.
